python --version
python -m pip --version
options: Version Strings Vary By Installed Python And Pip.

vERSION STRINGS VARY BY INSTALLED pYTHON AND PIP.
questions.answer: Version strings vary by installed Python and pip.
questions.explanation:
Terminal commands
`python --version` — Prints the active Python interpreter's version; your platform may use `python3` or `py` instead.
`python -m pip --version` — Shows pip attached to that interpreter; `python -m pip` makes the selected Python explicit.

questions.explanation:
LINE-BY-LINE WALKTHROUGH
`import sys` — Imports functionality from a module; without it, the name is unavailable and may raise NameError.
`print(sys.version_info.major >= 3)` — Runs an expression; print displays a value and calls may have side effects—without the line, that action does not occur.
